physicalNotes: Radius 0.697 +/- 0.005 solar radii from Borsato et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1130 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...689A..52B/abstract): 484,903 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.745 +/- 0.007 solar masses from Borsato et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1130 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...689A..52B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4360 +/- 108 K from Borsato et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1130 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...689A..52B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
